annotation.title_clean: Request for Information on the Development of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Action Plan
annotation.title_en: Request for Information on the Development of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Action Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Science Foundation (NITRD National Coordination Office) on behalf of OSTP
annotation.summary_en: Federal Register notice in which NSF/NITRD, for OSTP, requests public input for the AI Action Plan directed by Executive Order 14179. It aims to sustain US AI dominance and avoid burdensome requirements. Topics include chips, data centers, security, standards and regulation. The excerpt also contains unrelated notices (ATF, NSF meetings, Postal Regulatory Commission).
key_provisions_or_claims: Seeks public comment on priority policy actions for the AI Action Plan, due March 15, 2025.
Implements Executive Order 14179 on removing barriers to American AI leadership.
Notes revocation of Biden EO 14110 as burdensome to private-sector innovation.
Topics include hardware, data centers, cybersecurity, standards, regulation, export controls.
Responses are voluntary, limited to 15 pages, and may be reused by government.
